method: Read full collected answer text; link targets trusted per user and not reopened. Each entry records application or exclusion.

entries.topic: Does the Ixian ally see the bought card before swapping it?
entries.decision: Inspect the bought card before each immediate swap; cache auction excluded, Black Market included.

entries.topic: Can the Bene Gesserit free advisor go to the Polar Sink?
entries.decision: Polar Sink remains a choice; existing fighters must first flip by Intrusion before an accompanying advisor can join them.

entries.topic: Can Ecaz win by occupying strongholds with an ally?
entries.decision: Three co-occupied strongholds suffice. Preserve existing verified Ecaz Homeworld stock; conflict over both Emperor worlds versus two other factions flagged for root judgement rather than silently choosing.

entries.topic: Can Bene Gesserit advisors share a territory with their ally?
entries.decision: Use official advisor separation and later-player evacuation; reject unofficial coexistence default.

entries.topic: Do Bene Gesserit advisors count for controlling a stronghold?
entries.decision: Advisors do not control or block. Alone they flip; unresolved storm conflict prevents victory counting.

entries.topic: Does the Emperor's extra ally revival stack with the Tleilaxu increase?
entries.decision: Emperor extra three stacks with Tleilaxu limit five for total eight; not for Emperor itself.

entries.topic: How does the Bene Gesserit prediction win work?
entries.decision: Choose one other faction and turn before traitors; normal allied win can trigger, special wins cannot.

entries.topic: What is the difference between the Ixian bidding and technology advantages?
entries.decision: Auction inspection extra draw differs from once-per-phase hand swap; full hand permits swap.

entries.topic: Can more than one Sardaukar or Fedaykin be revived per turn?
entries.decision: At most one elite force of each faction revived per turn despite Ghola, Emperor or Tleilaxu.

entries.topic: Can the Emperor revive a leader as well as three forces?
entries.decision: Eligible leader revival is additional to normal force revival. Emperor special Karama is forces OR leader.

entries.topic: Can the Bene Gesserit use Worthless cards as Karama?
entries.decision: Worthless-as-Karama repeatable in Advanced; prevention discards Worthless card.

entries.topic: How do the Ixians choose their starting treachery card?
entries.decision: Use explicit official one-per-faction initial inspection; Harkonnen extra afterward.

entries.topic: Are Sardaukar worth 1 or 2 against the Fremen?
entries.decision: Sardaukar are ordinary versus all Fremen forces, not only Fedaykin.

entries.topic: Where do the Bene Gesserit start in the advanced game?
entries.decision: One advanced starting advisor anywhere instead of a Polar Sink force, not an additional force.

entries.topic: How does the Emperor take losses with a mix of Sardaukar and normal forces?
entries.decision: Choose casualties matching dial and support, including several valid mixes.

entries.topic: Can the Bene Gesserit Voice the opponent of their ally?
entries.decision: Bene Gesserit may Voice its ally's opponent.

entries.topic: How do Ixian Cyborgs and Suboids take losses, and what if Karama weakens Cyborgs?
entries.decision: Pay exact troop strength losses; Karama only clamps an excessive maximum; remaining Suboids may replace lost Cyborgs.

entries.topic: Can an Ixian ally swap a card bought from Richese or the Black Market?
entries.decision: Ixian swap allowed for Black Market, not cache; Harkonnen bonus applies to both.

entries.topic: Can the Hidden Mobile Stronghold be used without the Ixians?
entries.decision: HMS without Ixians is a community implementation toggle, outside default GF9.

entries.topic: How does the Cheap Hero traitor card work?
entries.decision: Cheap Hero traitor can betray multiple Cheap Heroes over the game.

entries.topic: Can Karama stop an alliance ability, such as CHOAM or Richese ones?
entries.decision: Normal Karama can stop alliance abilities; expansion table need not repeat general permission.

entries.topic: Can Karama be used to pay for someone else's shipment?
entries.decision: Any player's normal shipment may be bought at Guild rates paid to Bank; no extra shipment.

entries.topic: Why was the Karama card reworded?
entries.decision: Updated CHOAM copies replace original Karama; use corrected wording.

entries.topic: Can Karama stop Harkonnen calling a traitor in an ally's battle?
entries.decision: Ally-battle Harkonnen traitor can be prevented; own battle reveal and hand limit cannot.

entries.topic: When can each faction use its advanced Karama power, and is it once per game?
entries.decision: Use source timing table and once-per-game limit; Bene Gesserit has no separate special power.

entries.topic: What does Karama do against the Emperor?
entries.decision: Cancel one Emperor payment, affected gift, extra revivals or Sardaukar bonus; preserve normal allied payment aid.

entries.topic: Can you use a treachery card to help your ally in their battle?
entries.decision: Battle-plan cards belong to participant; third-party anytime cards follow their own timing.

entries.topic: Can allies show each other their treachery cards and battle plans?
entries.decision: Share or show information to anyone privately or publicly; reject stricter community secrecy.

entries.topic: What does the Richese alliance give the ally?
entries.decision: Richese may ship ally by immediately revealed No-Field and gift a cache-origin card from hand if space.

entries.topic: What happens to a player's forces and spice if they leave the game?
entries.decision: WBC player-dropout procedure has no official GF9 source here; do not silently import it.

entries.topic: If allies end up in the same territory after a Nexus, whose forces must leave?
entries.decision: Retain later-player evacuation for newly allied co-occupation, not revised end-of-each-turn casualties.

entries.topic: What does the Fremen alliance give the ally?
entries.decision: Fremen chooses protection and three free allied revivals; ally shares special victory.

entries.topic: Which leader can Harkonnen capture after winning a battle?
entries.decision: Capture randomly from eligible living loser leaders; include just-used survivor, exclude used elsewhere.

entries.topic: Does the CHOAM Auditor interact with Atreides Prescience?
entries.decision: No collected answer to Auditor versus Prescience. Apply existing timing; invent no special interaction.

entries.topic: Are the Fremen's allies protected from sandworms?
entries.decision: Fremen protection is discretionary; reject mandatory WBC2019 protection.

entries.topic: Can Juice of Sapho be played in a Richese once-around auction to bid last?
entries.decision: Juice of Sapho can make a bidder last in Once Around.

entries.topic: Can you play with bigger alliances or a different stronghold win count?
entries.decision: Optional alliance sizes and counts remain opt-in, default two/four.

entries.topic: How do the Ecaz Loyalty and Collection advantages work?
entries.decision: Loyalty setup protected from Karama; full co-occupied stronghold income for each ally.

entries.topic: How long can players negotiate alliances during a Nexus?
entries.decision: Do not add the unofficial five-minute Nexus limit.

entries.topic: Can the Nullentropy Box take itself back from the discard pile?
entries.decision: Nullentropy cannot retrieve itself; full-hand swap allowed, selection stays secret.

entries.topic: When Harkonnen reveal a traitor in an ally's battle, who wins and who gets the spice?
entries.decision: Harkonnen ally is the battle winner and receives leader spice, not Harkonnen supplying traitor.

entries.topic: Can Duke Vidal be revived with the Ghola card?
entries.decision: Only Ecaz can revive Vidal, including via Ghola.

entries.topic: Is your spice behind the shield secret?
entries.decision: Spice holdings stay private; voluntary disclosure allowed.

entries.topic: If an ally gets Prescience, Voice or a traitor call in the ally's battle, who uses it?
entries.decision: Do not override faction sheets with WBC allocation of who chooses alliance battle powers.

entries.topic: Can a Karama cancel a treachery card such as Hajr?
entries.decision: Karama cancels faction advantages, not an ordinary Hajr card; Worthless conversion is a faction advantage.

entries.topic: Can the Kwisatz Haderach be used together with a Cheap Hero?
entries.decision: KH accompanies a leader or Cheap Hero; no unrelated Avalon Hill Paul restriction.

entries.topic: How is spice split when Ecaz and their ally collect together?
entries.decision: Agree desert split or ally gets odd spice; each gains full stronghold income in Advanced.

entries.topic: If a Karama stops your faction ability, can you change what you were doing?
entries.decision: After canceled advantage choose a legal adjusted action respecting cancellation, such as one-territory Fremen move.

entries.topic: Can CHOAM discard a Snooper and a Shield Snooper as duplicates?
entries.decision: Duplicate sale requires exact card name; Shield Snooper and Portable Snooper are not Snooper.

entries.topic: Can Atreides tell other players what the treachery card up for bid is?
entries.decision: Atreides can show or tell anyone the current card; information need not be public to all.

entries.topic: Which treachery cards can Atreides look at during bidding?
entries.decision: Inspect only current offered card, not unsold later cards or Harkonnen bonus.

entries.topic: Can Ecaz Ambassadors be destroyed by the storm?
entries.decision: Storm/explosions return Ambassadors to supply; cannot place under storm.

entries.topic: What happens when Harass and Withdraw is played with Ecaz and an ally in the territory?
entries.decision: Harass withdraws only the playing faction's undialed troops in Ecaz battle.

entries.topic: What do CHOAM's Worthless card effects do?
entries.decision: CHOAM reactive Worthless effects occur at relevant triggers; Trip to Gamont may stop a win before victory check.

entries.topic: Can Karama stop the Fremen giving their ally free revivals?
entries.decision: Karama can stop Fremen free-revival alliance use under general alliance cancellation.

entries.topic: Can any player use Karama to ship at the Guild rate?
entries.decision: Do not import WBC own-shipment-only restriction over official Karama permission to buy ally shipment.

entries.topic: Do Reinforcements and Harass and Withdraw count as weapons or defenses?
entries.decision: Reinforcements and Harass replace a slot but are neither weapon nor defense for Prescience.

entries.topic: Which territories are adjacent on the Dune board?
entries.decision: Count territory borders, not sector lines; actual storm remains obstruction.

entries.topic: Can anyone enter the Polar Sink?
entries.decision: Polar Sink accessible to everyone, never stormed, no battles.

entries.topic: How many players can play Dune with all expansions?
entries.decision: Twelve factions are choices; recommend at most six players, larger games an experiment.

entries.topic: What happens when CHOAM uses Trip to Gamont on Richese with a No-Field token?
entries.decision: Trip reveals No-Field then returns one actual force; 0 still spends the card.

entries.topic: Do forces that moved into different sectors of the same territory act as one group?
entries.decision: Same-territory sector groups may move together and must fight together unless storm separates.

entries.topic: When does Atreides look at the top spice card, and what if the deck is reshuffled?
entries.decision: Inspect one top Spice Card at start of Shipment and Movement, not both Advanced draws.

entries.topic: How do you ship to another faction's homeworld, and what does occupying it give?
entries.decision: One normal shipment between worlds; Heighliners triggers; only Guild ships from Arrakis absent granted exception.

entries.topic: How do Kaitain's Low Threshold and occupied effects combine?
entries.decision: Five-spice Kaitain split is Emperor three/occupier two; Harkonnen benefit totals two for phase.

entries.topic: Does a dead Kwisatz Haderach change Atreides leader revival?
entries.decision: KH alive/dead never changes five-leader revival eligibility.

entries.topic: Does the storm over Arrakeen or Carthag affect the ornithopter move?
entries.decision: Storm over an occupied city does not itself remove ornithopters; route cannot cross storm.

entries.topic: Who manages the treachery and spice decks?
entries.decision: Atreides manages Spice and Treachery decks.

entries.topic: Can you move forces from several territories in one Shipment and Movement phase?
entries.decision: One group from one origin to one destination per movement; extra range is not extra groups.

entries.topic: Can CHOAM's Kull Wahad stop a Karama?
entries.decision: Direct designer: Kull Wahad stops that player's Karama for entire phase; prevented Karama retained. Sent author for correction.

entries.topic: How do the Emperor's two homeworlds work?
entries.decision: Kaitain only Basic; add Salusa Advanced, respective revivals, shared shipment, no Salusa charity/revival bonus.

entries.topic: Can the Kwisatz Haderach token be killed in battle?
entries.decision: Only explosion kills KH, ordinary accompanied leader death merely removes that battle bonus.

entries.topic: What happens if a Prescience answer becomes impossible to follow?
entries.decision: If later legal effect makes revealed answer impossible, give updated legal answer; no new unrelated question.

entries.topic: What happens when a revived leader is killed again?
entries.decision: Second death face down; wait other revivable leaders' death cycle unless explicit exception.

entries.topic: Can Juice of Sapho be played after battle plans are revealed?
entries.decision: Direct designer allows Juice of Sapho after reveal; sent author for explicit card-timing correction.

entries.topic: Does CHOAM Charity trigger the Spice Production Tech Token?
entries.decision: CHOAM/BG special charity alone does not trigger token; income comes from Bank, unaffected by Inflation.

entries.topic: Where do revived forces go, and who gets the revival spice?
entries.decision: Revived forces go to reserves; Bank receives cost except redirected Tleilaxu payments.

entries.topic: What happens when three factions are in the same territory?
entries.decision: Aggressor fights sequential opponents while surviving; entry limit still blocks third ordinary stronghold faction.

entries.topic: How do you set up starting positions and traitors in a 6-player game?
entries.decision: Correct collected summary typo: Emperor has twenty reserves and none in Arrakeen, as explicit source sheet states.

entries.topic: How does a CHOAM audit work when the player has only one card?
entries.decision: Audit payment equals available cards actually inspectable; no partial-payment reduction.

entries.topic: Does the Bene Gesserit choose their prediction or is it random?
entries.decision: Bene Gesserit deliberately chooses prediction after player positions, before traitors.

entries.topic: How do players choose which faction to play?
entries.decision: Use random faction cards or descending turn-card choice, with swaps allowed.

entries.topic: Can Moritani put Terror tokens on a homeworld or in the Hidden Mobile Stronghold?
entries.decision: No Terror on Homeworld or HMS; Homeworld territory exclusions remain.

entries.topic: Does CHOAM get spice when someone uses the Arrakeen Stronghold card?
entries.decision: Arrakeen support paid by card counts toward CHOAM support-income calculation.

entries.topic: When does the Bene Gesserit get a free Spiritual Advisor, for example after a Guild cross-ship or Fremen shipment?
entries.decision: Off-planet to Arrakis triggers advisor, including HMS; no cross-ship/Fremen trigger; existing fighters need Intrusion flip.

entries.topic: Does CHOAM Inflation affect Tupile or homeworld charity?
entries.decision: Low Homeworld adds charity only to actually eligible recipient; it does not increase eligibility threshold. Inflation interaction not inferred beyond explicit effects.

entries.topic: Can the Bene Gesserit send advisors to a homeworld?
entries.decision: No advisors on Homeworlds or Intrusion there; non-native traitor restrictions apply.

entries.topic: What does CHOAM start with, and how does CHOAM revival work?
entries.decision: CHOAM starts twenty reserves, two spice, zero free revival; unlimited paid forces at one each.

entries.topic: Can the Bene Gesserit send a Spiritual Advisor when the Ixians ship into the Hidden Mobile Stronghold?
entries.decision: Free advisor may accompany Ixian shipment directly into HMS.

entries.topic: When does the Bene Gesserit make their prediction, and when do the Fremen place their forces?
entries.decision: Prediction timing and Fremen-before-BG setup already explicit; no additional tournament setup doctrine imported.

entries.topic: Can the Bene Gesserit Voice affect the Kwisatz Haderach?
entries.decision: Voice targets permitted cards, not KH token or dial; can affect protection of accompanied leader indirectly.

entries.topic: Can you ally with a faction that occupies your homeworld?
entries.decision: Cannot ally with Homeworld occupier or invade ally Homeworld.

entries.topic: How much does it cost to ship forces to Dune?
entries.decision: One per force stronghold, two elsewhere, redirected to Guild if present.

entries.topic: How much spice does CHOAM get from other factions' battles?
entries.decision: Half battle support rounded down to CHOAM; no traitor payment; include Arrakeen card support.

entries.topic: Can you ship forces from the board back to your reserves?
entries.decision: Only Guild can normally return to reserves, ally cannot inherit that option.

entries.topic: What happens to forces on a homeworld in a lasgun-shield explosion?
entries.decision: Explosion destroys only native printed battle-strength count; invaders lose normally, both lose battle.

entries.topic: Do you need to occupy a stronghold alone, or for the whole turn, to get its spice bonus?
entries.decision: Occupy at collection time, not entire turn; advisors neither collect nor block another faction's control.

entries.topic: What do Karama cards do against Moritani and Ecaz?
entries.decision: Use explicit expansion Karama limits; cannot stop Moritani assassination or Ecaz Loyalty.

entries.topic: Can bribes be made while CHOAM's Inflation token is on Double?
entries.decision: No bribes while Inflation Double side face up.

entries.topic: What do Moritani and Ecaz start with?
entries.decision: Use distinct Ecaz Imperial Basin setup and Moritani after-others unoccupied setup.

entries.topic: Can CHOAM pay for their ally's spice support in battle?
entries.decision: CHOAM may pay allied battle support to Bank.

entries.topic: What happens when the spice deck runs out?
entries.decision: Reshuffle entire exhausted Spice Deck including both Advanced piles; do not import fixed WBC turn-seven procedure.

entries.topic: Can Bene Gesserit advisors play Family Atomics?
entries.decision: Advisors cannot enable Family Atomics.

entries.topic: Can the CHOAM Auditor be captured, made a Ghola or given a Leader Skill?
entries.decision: Auditor cannot be ghola, captive or skilled; its one-per-phase leader revival is always eligible.

entries.topic: How does Double Spice Blow work, and which pile does Shai-Hulud hit?
entries.decision: Specific Advanced sequence prevails: per-pile Nexus and ride, up to two alliance windows. CORE016 corrected after independent review.

entries.topic: What does the Moritani Atomics Terror token and its Aftermath do?
entries.decision: Atomics kills all, bars shipment including Fremen, reduces Moritani/ally hand; Sneak Attack explicit exception.

entries.topic: Do you have to tell other players how many treachery cards you hold?
entries.decision: Hand count public throughout Bidding, may be hidden at other times.

entries.topic: How many treachery cards are put up for auction, and what happens if everyone passes?
entries.decision: Deal one per eligible bidder; rotate opening bidder; all pass returns unsold cards and ends round.

entries.topic: How does Moritani's Assassinate Leaders work?
entries.decision: Assassinate only other matching-faction leader after surviving opponent and no traitor; one per faction, normal traitor use forfeits.

entries.topic: Where is the spice placed when a territory spans several sectors?
entries.decision: Place spice in printed blow-icon sector.

entries.topic: Is there a time limit for bidding in Dune?
entries.decision: Ten-second bid deadline retained.

entries.topic: What is the exact order of the Spice Blow phase with Shai-Hulud, the Nexus and worm riding?
entries.decision: Do not import WBC eating-after-Nexus ordering; exact GF9 timing judgement kept explicit.

entries.topic: What does the Moritani alliance give the ally?
entries.decision: Moritani ally may retain one otherwise retainable card after losing a battle with a winner.

entries.topic: What happens when the treachery deck runs out?
entries.decision: Reshuffle exhausted Treachery discards; Family Atomics stays removed.

entries.topic: Does Harkonnen get a free card when buying a Richese or Black Market card?
entries.decision: Harkonnen bonus card for cache and Black Market buys.

entries.topic: What happens if a player makes an illegal bid?
entries.decision: No official invalid-bid restart penalty supplied; do not import WBC offender exclusion.

entries.topic: How does the storm move when the Fremen aren't in the game?
entries.decision: Dial without Advanced Fremen; always-deck is optional variant, not default.

entries.topic: What does the Moritani Sabotage Terror token do?
entries.decision: Sabotage discards a random enemy card if possible, then optional gift.

entries.topic: What if a player ends up with more treachery cards than their hand limit?
entries.decision: No blanket random-discard rule imported. Each official over-limit effect specifies its own remedy.

entries.topic: How are storm sectors counted when the storm moves?
entries.decision: Counterclockwise distance counts entered sectors; first turn zero-to-twenty dials.

entries.topic: Can the two players who dial the storm agree on the number?
entries.decision: Secret simultaneous dials do not create an unwritten ban on legal Advanced negotiation. Keep choices secret until reveal.

entries.topic: What does Karama do against CHOAM?
entries.decision: Use explicit cancellations and once-per-game CHOAM special discard benefit; already placed Inflation flip unaffected.

entries.topic: Does Family Atomics affect the sector the storm is in?
entries.decision: No retroactive effect on current storm sector; source force or wall being stormed does not itself forbid launch.

entries.topic: Do you have to discard your Nexus card when you form an alliance?
entries.decision: Discard Nexus Card to ally; redraw only at qualifying unallied window; own-card redraw allowed.

entries.topic: How many weapon and defense cards can a battle plan have, and can you add cards with a Cheap Hero?
entries.decision: One weapon and one defense; Cheap Hero is leader substitute and always discarded.

entries.topic: Can you move through a territory that is only partly in the storm?
entries.decision: Clear-sector route permitted in partially stormed territory; use current Fremen restriction not old community exception.

entries.topic: What does Karama do against Richese?
entries.decision: Richese cache auction, No-Field shipment and Black Market may be stopped.

entries.topic: Can forces in a storm sector move to a clear sector of the same territory?
entries.decision: No movement out of storm even to same-territory clear sector; clear-to-clear reposition uses movement.

entries.topic: Must the Secret Ally Nexus effect be played before Prescience?
entries.decision: BG Secret Ally before Prescience; Tleilaxu gained card is Face Dancer; Moritani betrayal removes one token only.

entries.topic: What are the special Karama powers of CHOAM and Richese?
entries.decision: CHOAM discard and Richese purchase are separate once-per-game advanced Karama powers usable anytime.

entries.topic: Can you play a Cheap Hero instead of a weapon or defense card to get rid of it?
entries.decision: Cheap Hero cannot be thrown away in weapon/defense slot.

entries.topic: Does the losing leader die, and what happens to leaders who survive a battle?
entries.decision: Losing does not itself kill leader; weapons and explicit exceptional effects do.

entries.topic: How do Leader Skill cards work?
entries.decision: Retain skill timing, face-up general benefit, battle-specific use, discard-on-death and draw-on-own-revival.

entries.topic: Can battles happen in the Polar Sink?
entries.decision: Polar Sink never battles and permits allied co-occupation.

entries.topic: Does Richese with the Smuggler skill get a free force when shipping a No-Field token?
entries.decision: Smuggler extra force accompanies No-Field to empty destination.

entries.topic: Is spice destroyed when the storm passes over it?
entries.decision: Remove spice in crossed/final sectors, not other sectors of same territory.

entries.topic: Can you ship forces into a sector in the storm?
entries.decision: No storm shipment except Advanced Fremen legal reserve placement with half loss.

entries.topic: Does a Shield protect against the Poison Blade?
entries.decision: Poison Blade requires combined defense; Shield alone insufficient.

entries.topic: Can players separated by the storm in the same territory fight or ally?
entries.decision: Storm blocks relevant battle, not alliance formation; apply later evacuation rule afterward.

entries.topic: Can a leader with the Mentat skill still fight after using it?
entries.decision: Mentat can be used before plan then same leader selected to fight.

entries.topic: How do Ixian Cyborgs fight against Fremen Fedaykin?
entries.decision: Cyborgs retain double against Fremen but require spice; only Sardaukar has Fremen reduction.

entries.topic: Do Fedaykin count double for Fremen storm losses?
entries.decision: Storm halves tokens, not battle strength; no Fedaykin double-loss penalty.

entries.topic: Can you win a battle if you lose all your forces?
entries.decision: Win can leave no surviving forces; keep normal winner benefits.

entries.topic: Can the Ixian Technology advantage be used more than once?
entries.decision: Technology once per Bidding Phase, not game; swaps hand card with auction card.

entries.topic: Does the Spice Banker skill pay out on revival?
entries.decision: Spice Banker triggers qualifying Bank revival payments, not payments redirected elsewhere.

entries.topic: Can Weather Control or Family Atomics be played on the first turn?
entries.decision: No Weather Control or Family Atomics on turn one.

entries.topic: Can you change your battle plan before it is revealed?
entries.decision: May revise unfixed plan elements until commitment; respect Voice, Prescience, Karama and Truthtrance.

entries.topic: Does Weather Control add to the storm's normal movement, and can it stop the storm?
entries.decision: Weather Control replaces distance; zero enters no new sectors and does not repeat storm damage.

entries.topic: Are deals between players binding?
entries.decision: Binding possible public terms persist; impossible terms void, unanimous cancellation allowed.

entries.topic: Can Shai-Hulud devour forces in a territory under the storm?
entries.decision: No special storm-versus-worm answer collected. Apply stated general worm destruction; add no invented immunity or timing exception.

entries.topic: Does a Traitor card the Tleilaxu gain count as a traitor or a Face Dancer?
entries.decision: Rihani gives Tleilaxu a Face Dancer replacing unrevealed one, not a fourth or ordinary traitor.

entries.topic: What does it cost the Ixians to ship and revive Cyborgs and Suboids?
entries.decision: Normal shipping costs for both types; Cyborg paid revival three, Suboid normal two; HMS direct only Ixian/qualifying advisor.

entries.topic: If a card is won with Karama, does the Emperor still get paid?
entries.decision: Karama-free card creates no spice for Emperor to collect.

entries.topic: Can the Hidden Mobile Stronghold be placed in the Polar Sink?
entries.decision: HMS may point at Polar Sink sector; cannot point at original stronghold.

entries.topic: Do the Fremen's free revivals for an ally count against the ally's revival limit?
entries.decision: Keep three free within applicable limit; collected on-top summary conflicts actual wording and community consensus.

entries.topic: Does Zoal copy a leader's skill bonus?
entries.decision: Zoal copies printed leader value only, not KH or Leader Skill bonus.

entries.topic: Can the Fremen combine their two-territory move with ornithopters?
entries.decision: Ornithopter three replaces Fremen two; ranges do not add.

entries.topic: Can the Ixians spend spice to strengthen Suboids?
entries.decision: Suboids permanently half strength, no spice needed or permitted improvement; survivors can replace Cyborg losses.

entries.topic: How are Tech Tokens assigned at the start of the game?
entries.decision: Assign preferred tokens to present factions, remainder randomly by poststorm order to factions without one.

entries.topic: How long does a game of Dune take and how many turns can it last?
entries.decision: Maximum ten turns; omit variable community duration statistics from rules.

entries.topic: Does the game end as soon as someone reaches the victory condition mid-turn?
entries.decision: Normal victory checked at Mentat Pause, not midturn.

entries.topic: Can you win Dune on the first turn?
entries.decision: Turn-one Mentat check can produce ordinary victory; no first-turn exemption.

entries.topic: How far can Ixian Cyborgs and Suboids move, and how much spice can they carry?
entries.decision: Cyborg move two/collect three; Suboids move two with Cyborg else one, collect and occupy normally.

entries.topic: Are faction abilities mandatory or optional?
entries.decision: Respect may/can optional wording and mandatory gets; no discretionary refusal of Harkonnen bonus.

entries.topic: How do you take a Tech Token from another player, and is it mandatory?
entries.decision: Winner takes one token if any, choosing among several; not an optional refusal.

entries.topic: What do the Ixians start with?
entries.decision: Three Cyborg and three Suboid in HMS, remaining fourteen reserves, ten spice, one free either type.

entries.topic: Where does the card the Ixians remove from the auction go?
entries.decision: Choose top OR bottom of deck; reject WBC bottom-only restriction.

entries.topic: Does a Tleilaxu Ghola get a Leader Skill card?
entries.decision: Acquiring foreign ghola earns no skill draw; revive own leader without skill to qualify.

entries.topic: Can the Ixians swap a treachery card when their hand is full?
entries.decision: Full hand permits equal Technology swap, as swapping does not add card count.

entries.topic: If several factions trigger a Tech Token, do you collect once or for each?
entries.decision: Once per phase per relevant token, scaled by holder total, excluding native-only triggers.

entries.topic: Is a traitor card discarded after it is revealed?
entries.decision: Revealed traitor remains held and reusable for revived leader; never consumed by call.

entries.topic: Does the Master of Assassins skill work with Chemistry?
entries.decision: Chemistry must actually play as poison weapon for Master of Assassins benefit.

entries.topic: What are the special Karama powers of the Ixians and Tleilaxu?
entries.decision: Once-per-game special Karama: HMS additional two movement, or cancel revival.

entries.topic: Can you answer 'I don't know' to a Truthtrance question?
entries.decision: Unknown beyond ability permits new question or saving card; no binding future-turn action.

entries.topic: Can Karama be used to get a Richese treachery card?
entries.decision: No Karama taking/free buying/overbidding in Richese cache or Black Market auctions.

entries.topic: Do CHOAM and the Tleilaxu get half-price revival for all forces when allied?
entries.decision: CHOAM alliance discount halves total revival cost, round total up.

entries.topic: How does Distrans work?
entries.decision: Distrans one own hand card to recipient with room, except during a bid; cache entry not main setup deck.

entries.topic: When can the Tleilaxu offer to revive another faction's leader?
entries.decision: One early own-leader revival per other faction, normal when eligible; Tleilaxu itself has separately unlimited leader revival.

entries.topic: What does the CHOAM alliance give the ally?
entries.decision: One two-way allied card trade per turn at phase end, and CHOAM may support ally battle.

entries.topic: Are used Richese cards shuffled into the treachery deck, and can you use them without Richese?
entries.decision: Discarded cache cards enter normal cycle; no starting-cache shuffle without Richese, per direct designer intent.

entries.topic: When are Face Dancers replaced, and can the Tleilaxu swap them?
entries.decision: Only unrevealed Face Dancer may be swapped each Mentat; revealed reset together after all three.

entries.topic: Does a No-Field shipment trigger the Heighliners Tech Token?
entries.decision: No-Field costs one-force shipment and triggers Heighliners except Guild ally-only shipment.

entries.topic: Can a Ghola leader be called as a traitor?
entries.decision: Ghola traitor requires matching held card; no automatic betrayal against original faction.

entries.topic: Does the Tleilaxu Ghola ability work when they already have 5 leaders?
entries.decision: Foreign ghola acquisition only below five active leaders, up to five.

entries.topic: Who pays when Richese ships an ally's forces with a No-Field token?
entries.decision: Either ally pays No-Field one-force price to Guild or Bank; forces reveal immediately.

entries.topic: Do the Tleilaxu get Traitor cards at setup?
entries.decision: Tleilaxu skips initial four-card traitor choice; receives three Face Dancers after others return cards.

entries.topic: What does Richese start with?
entries.decision: Twenty reserves, five spice, ten-card separate cache, No-Field zero/three/five, two free revival.

entries.topic: Where do the Tleilaxu forces that replace a Face Dancer victim come from?
entries.decision: Replacement forces come from reserves and/or anywhere on planet, up to returned winner count.

entries.topic: How does Richese count for the Fremen special victory?
entries.decision: Richese at Tuek's blocks Fremen special victory.

entries.topic: Does the battle winner still collect spice and keep cards when a Face Dancer is revealed?
entries.decision: Winner keeps battle benefits; Face Dancer killed without extra spice, surviving troops return to reserves not Tanks.

entries.topic: Can Karama stop the Tleilaxu Face Dancer?
entries.decision: Karama stops only Mentat Face Dancer replacement, not reveal or takeover.

entries.topic: How strong is Zoal against a Cheap Hero?
entries.decision: Zoal zero versus Cheap Hero; death spice based copied printed value, not a weapon kill bonus.

entries.topic: What do the Tleilaxu start with?
entries.decision: Tleilaxu starts twenty reserves, five spice, two free revivals and three Face Dancers.

entries.topic: How are Stronghold Cards claimed and passed on?
entries.decision: Claim at Mentat beginning after turn-one play, not setup; keep until next transfer window.

entries.topic: Can a revealed Face Dancer be used again?
entries.decision: Revealed Face Dancer inactive until full reset, unlike persistent ordinary traitor.

entries.topic: Do the Bene Gesserit lose a Stronghold Card when they flip to advisors?
entries.decision: BG advisor flip does not immediately remove card; transfer/set aside at Mentat.

entries.topic: Do Bene Gesserit advisors trigger Ambassadors and Terror tokens?
entries.decision: Advisors excluded from Ambassador trigger, included for Terror.

entries.topic: How does the Discovery spice card work?
entries.decision: Discovery blow destroys old spice/forces, places six in blow sector and separate random token at printed token site.

entries.topic: What do the Discovery tokens do?
entries.decision: Five nested locations, no immediate occupation upon reveal; next-turn free entry then normal entry/shipment rules.

entries.topic: Does the Ecaz Occupy bonus round up or down?
entries.decision: Follow normative round-up bonus/loss and round-down survivors, correcting printed example.

entries.topic: Does Ecaz Occupy apply to Tech Tokens, strongholds and ornithopters?
entries.decision: Both allies gain city ornithopters; all Tech Tokens must be held by one, no shared synthetic stronghold.

entries.topic: Can Ecaz in Sietch Tabr stop the Fremen special victory?
entries.decision: Ecaz co-occupation with Fremen does not block special win; Fedaykin keep full no-spice value.
